## Abidjan 
## Screening model

```{r}
# ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║         ABIDJAN SCREENING: Per-Covariate Support + Grid Scaling      ║
# ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

library(INLA)
library(inlabru)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# ==================== CONFIGURATION ====================

GRID_FILE     <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Abidjan/R_data/abidjan_grid30m_master_merged_withDV.csv"
SITES_FILE    <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Abidjan/Abidjan_site_locations.csv"
BOUNDARY_FILE <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Abidjan/R_data/Abidjan.shp"
OUTPUT_DIR    <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Abidjan/R_data/screening_final"

dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

CRS_METR <- 32630
CRS_LL   <- 4326

DISTANCE_THRESHOLD <- 150  # meters

# Full variable set
VARIABLE_NAMES <- c(
  'rwi_interp'                   = 'Relative Wealth Index',
  'ntl_bilinear'                 = 'Night Time Lights',
  'slum_mean30m'                 = 'Slum Likelihood',
  'mean_footprint_area_m2_250m'  = 'Footprint Area (Mean)',
  'accessibility_index'          = 'Accessibility Index',
  'spacing_median_m_250m'        = 'Footprint Spacing',
  'orientation_dispersion_250m'  = 'Orientation Dispersion',
  'u18_bilinear'                 = 'Under 18 Population',
  'built_environment_index'      = 'Built Environment Index',
  'dist_secondary_m'             = 'Distance to Secondary Roads',
  'dist_tertiary_m'              = 'Distance to Tertiary Roads',
  'clark_evans_R_net_250m'       = 'Clark Evans R Index',
  'dist_to_mask_edge_m_250m'     = 'Distance to Open Space',
  'civ_general_2020'             = 'Population Density'
)
covars <- names(VARIABLE_NAMES)

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SCREENING: Per-Covariate Support + Grid-Based Z-Scoring\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# ==================== LOAD DATA ====================

grid  <- read.csv(GRID_FILE, check.names = FALSE)
sites <- read.csv(SITES_FILE, check.names = FALSE)

grid_coords  <- if(all(c("x","y") %in% names(grid))) c("x","y") else c("longitude","latitude")
sites_coords <- if(all(c("x","y") %in% names(sites))) c("x","y") else c("longitude","latitude")
coord_crs    <- if(max(abs(grid[[grid_coords[1]]])) > 180) CRS_METR else CRS_LL

boundary <- st_read(BOUNDARY_FILE, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(CRS_METR) %>% st_make_valid()
grid_sf  <- st_as_sf(grid, coords = grid_coords, crs = coord_crs) %>% st_transform(CRS_METR)
sites_sf <- st_as_sf(sites, coords = sites_coords, crs = coord_crs) %>% st_transform(CRS_METR)

area_col <- if("area_m2" %in% names(sites)) "area_m2" else "area"
sites_sf$log_area <- log(sites[[area_col]])

# Filter to available covariates
missing <- setdiff(covars, names(grid))
if(length(missing) > 0) {
  cat("⚠ Missing covariates (dropped):", paste(missing, collapse=", "), "\n\n")
  covars <- intersect(covars, names(grid))
  VARIABLE_NAMES <- VARIABLE_NAMES[covars]
}

message("✓ ", nrow(grid_sf), " grid points, ", nrow(sites_sf), " sites, ", length(covars), " covariates")

# ==================== CORRELATION ====================

cat("\nComputing correlation matrix...\n")
cov_data <- st_drop_geometry(grid_sf)[, covars]
cor_matrix <- suppressWarnings(cor(cov_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))

png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "correlation_plot.png"), width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", tl.col = "black", tl.cex = 0.7,
         addCoef.col = "black", number.cex = 0.5,
         col = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(200),
         title = "Correlation Matrix", mar = c(0,0,2,0))
dev.off()
message("✓ Saved correlation plot")

# ==================== MESH & SPDE ====================

mesh <- fm_mesh_2d(
  boundary = fm_as_segm(boundary),
  max.edge = c(500, 3000),
  cutoff   = 300,
  crs      = st_crs(CRS_METR)
)

spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(mesh, prior.range = c(800, 0.5), prior.sigma = c(2, 0.01))
message("✓ Mesh: ", mesh$n, " nodes\n")

# ==================== HELPERS ====================

# Distance-capped NN interpolation
interp_nn_cap <- function(target_pts, grid_valid, covar_name, max_dist) {
  if (nrow(grid_valid) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(target_pts)))
  idx <- st_nearest_feature(target_pts, grid_valid)
  dists <- as.numeric(st_distance(target_pts, grid_valid[idx, ], by_element = TRUE))
  vals <- st_drop_geometry(grid_valid)[[covar_name]][idx]
  vals[dists > max_dist] <- NA_real_
  vals
}

# Create support as buffered grid points
create_support <- function(grid_valid, buffer_m) {
  if (nrow(grid_valid) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  support <- grid_valid %>%
    st_buffer(buffer_m) %>%
    st_union() %>%
    st_make_valid() %>%
    st_intersection(boundary) %>%
    st_make_valid()
  
  if (length(support) == 0 || any(st_is_empty(support))) return(NULL)
  support
}

# ==================== FIT INDIVIDUAL MODELS ====================

fit_individual_model <- function(covar_name, covar_label) {
  cat(sprintf("%-40s", covar_label)); flush.console()
  
  # Valid grid points
  grid_valid <- grid_sf[is.finite(st_drop_geometry(grid_sf)[[covar_name]]), ]
  if (nrow(grid_valid) < 100) { cat("SKIPPED (few grid pts)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  # Support polygon
  support <- create_support(grid_valid, DISTANCE_THRESHOLD)
  if (is.null(support)) { cat("SKIPPED (no support)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  # Grid in support for z-scoring
  grid_in_support <- grid_valid[lengths(st_intersects(grid_valid, support)) > 0, ]
  if (nrow(grid_in_support) < 100) { cat("SKIPPED (few grid in support)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  g_vals <- st_drop_geometry(grid_in_support)[[covar_name]]
  g_mean <- mean(g_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  g_sd   <- sd(g_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(g_sd) || g_sd == 0) { cat("SKIPPED (no variation)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  # IPs in support
  ips <- fm_int(mesh, samplers = support)
  if (nrow(ips) < 200) { cat("SKIPPED (few IPs)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  ips$cov_raw <- interp_nn_cap(ips, grid_valid, covar_name, DISTANCE_THRESHOLD)
  ips$cov_z <- (ips$cov_raw - g_mean) / g_sd
  ips_clean <- ips[!is.na(ips$cov_z), ]
  if (nrow(ips_clean) < 200) { cat("SKIPPED (few valid IPs)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  # Sites in support
  sites_in_support <- sites_sf[lengths(st_intersects(sites_sf, support)) > 0, ]
  if (nrow(sites_in_support) < 10) { cat("SKIPPED (few sites)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  sites_in_support$cov_raw <- interp_nn_cap(sites_in_support, grid_valid, covar_name, DISTANCE_THRESHOLD)
  sites_in_support$cov_z <- (sites_in_support$cov_raw - g_mean) / g_sd
  sites_in_support[[paste0(covar_name, "_z")]] <- sites_in_support$cov_z
  sites_use <- sites_in_support[is.finite(sites_in_support$cov_z), ]
  
  if (nrow(sites_use) < 10) { cat("SKIPPED (few valid sites)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  scaled_name <- paste0(covar_name, "_z")
  support_km2 <- as.numeric(st_area(support)) / 1e6
  
  cat(sprintf("[%d/%d sites, %d IPs, %.1f km²] ", 
              nrow(sites_use), nrow(sites_sf), nrow(ips_clean), support_km2))
  
  # Components
  cmp <- ~ Intercept_pp(1) +
          field_pp(geometry, model = spde) +
          beta_pp(main = cov_z, model = "linear") +
          Intercept_mark(1) +
          beta_mark(main = get(scaled_name), model = "linear")
  
  # Likelihoods
  lh_pp <- like(family = "cp", formula = geometry ~ Intercept_pp + field_pp + beta_pp,
                data = sites_use, ips = ips_clean)
  lh_mark <- like(family = "gaussian", formula = log_area ~ Intercept_mark + beta_mark,
                  data = sites_use)
  
  # Fit
  fit <- try(bru(components = cmp, lh_pp, lh_mark,
                 options = list(control.inla = list(int.strategy = "eb"), bru_verbose = 0)),
             silent = TRUE)
  
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error") || is.null(fit) || is.null(fit$summary.fixed)) {
    cat("FAILED\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Results
  res <- list(
    covariate = covar_name,
    covariate_label = covar_label,
    pp_effect = fit$summary.fixed["beta_pp","mean"],
    pp_se = fit$summary.fixed["beta_pp","sd"],
    pp_ci_lower = fit$summary.fixed["beta_pp","0.025quant"],
    pp_ci_upper = fit$summary.fixed["beta_pp","0.975quant"],
    pp_significant = (fit$summary.fixed["beta_pp","0.025quant"] > 0 | fit$summary.fixed["beta_pp","0.975quant"] < 0),
    mark_effect = fit$summary.fixed["beta_mark","mean"],
    mark_se = fit$summary.fixed["beta_mark","sd"],
    mark_ci_lower = fit$summary.fixed["beta_mark","0.025quant"],
    mark_ci_upper = fit$summary.fixed["beta_mark","0.975quant"],
    mark_significant = (fit$summary.fixed["beta_mark","0.025quant"] > 0 | fit$summary.fixed["beta_mark","0.975quant"] < 0),
    spatial_range = fit$summary.hyperpar["Range for field_pp","mean"],
    spatial_sigma = fit$summary.hyperpar["Stdev for field_pp","mean"],
    dic = fit$dic$dic,
    n_sites_used = nrow(sites_use),
    n_ips_used = nrow(ips_clean),
    support_area_km2 = support_km2
  )
  
  cat(sprintf("✓ PP:%+.3f Mark:%+.3f\n", res$pp_effect, res$mark_effect))
  res
}

# ==================== RUN MODELS ====================

cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("FITTING MODELS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

start_time <- Sys.time()
all_results <- list()

for (i in seq_along(covars)) {
  r <- fit_individual_model(covars[i], VARIABLE_NAMES[covars[i]])
  if (!is.null(r)) all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- r
}

total_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "mins"))

cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat(sprintf("Completed %d / %d models in %.1f minutes\n", length(all_results), length(covars), total_time))
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# ==================== SAVE RESULTS ====================

if (length(all_results) > 0) {
  results_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_results, as.data.frame))
  
  saveRDS(list(results = results_df, cor_matrix = cor_matrix, mesh = mesh, spde = spde),
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "screening_results.rds"))
  write.csv(results_df, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "screening_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("✓ Results saved to:", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠ No models completed\n")
}
```

# Visualization of Screening results
```{r}
# ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║     TABLES & FIGURES FROM SAVED FILE (screening_results.rds)        ║
# ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
library(reshape2)   # for melt()

# ==================== CONFIG ====================
OUTPUT_DIR <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Abidjan/R_data/screening_final"
RDS_FILE   <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "screening_results.rds")

stopifnot(file.exists(RDS_FILE))

obj <- readRDS(RDS_FILE)
results_df <- obj$results

# Normalize column names
results_df <- results_df %>%
  rename(
    Label = covariate_label,
    PP_Effect = pp_effect,
    PP_SE = pp_se,
    PP_CI_Lower = pp_ci_lower,
    PP_CI_Upper = pp_ci_upper,
    PP_Significant = pp_significant,
    Mark_Effect = mark_effect,
    Mark_SE = mark_se,
    Mark_CI_Lower = mark_ci_lower,
    Mark_CI_Upper = mark_ci_upper,
    Mark_Significant = mark_significant,
    Spatial_Range = spatial_range,
    Spatial_Sigma = spatial_sigma,
    DIC = dic
  )

cor_matrix <- obj$cor_matrix

# If label column has a slightly different name, normalize it
if (!"Label" %in% names(results_df) && "covariate_label" %in% names(results_df)) {
  results_df$Label <- results_df$covariate_label
}

# Safety: ensure required columns exist
must_have <- c("Label","PP_Effect","PP_SE","PP_CI_Lower","PP_CI_Upper",
               "PP_Significant","Mark_Effect","Mark_SE","Mark_CI_Lower",
               "Mark_CI_Upper","Mark_Significant","Spatial_Range",
               "Spatial_Sigma","dic")
missing_cols <- setdiff(must_have, names(results_df))
if (length(missing_cols)) {
  warning("Missing columns in results_df: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse=", "))
}

# Normalize metric names to what plotting/tables expect
if (!"DIC" %in% names(results_df) && "dic" %in% names(results_df)) {
  results_df$DIC <- results_df$dic
}
if (!"WAIC" %in% names(results_df)) {
  results_df$WAIC <- NA_real_
}

# Derived fields for ranking
results_df <- results_df %>%
  mutate(
    PP_AbsEffect   = abs(PP_Effect),
    Mark_AbsEffect = abs(Mark_Effect)
  )

# ==================== TABLES ====================

# Table 1: Occurrence (WHERE)
pp_table <- results_df %>%
  arrange(desc(PP_AbsEffect)) %>%
  transmute(
    Predictor   = Label,
    Effect      = sprintf("%.4f", PP_Effect),
    `Std.Error` = sprintf("%.4f", PP_SE),
    CI.Lower    = sprintf("%.4f", PP_CI_Lower),
    CI.Upper    = sprintf("%.4f", PP_CI_Upper),
    Significant = PP_Significant,
    DIC         = sprintf("%.1f", DIC)
  )

cat("\n")
cat("╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat("║      TABLE 1: OCCURRENCE EFFECTS (WHERE SITES LOCATE)                 ║\n")
cat("╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n")
print(pp_table, row.names = FALSE)

# Table 2: Size (HOW LARGE)
mark_table <- results_df %>%
  arrange(desc(Mark_AbsEffect)) %>%
  transmute(
    Predictor   = Label,
    Effect      = sprintf("%.4f", Mark_Effect),
    `Std.Error` = sprintf("%.4f", Mark_SE),
    CI.Lower    = sprintf("%.4f", Mark_CI_Lower),
    CI.Upper    = sprintf("%.4f", Mark_CI_Upper),
    Significant = Mark_Significant,
    DIC         = sprintf("%.1f", DIC)
  )

cat("\n")
cat("╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat("║        TABLE 2: SIZE EFFECTS (HOW LARGE SITES BECOME)                 ║\n")
cat("╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n")
print(mark_table, row.names = FALSE)

# Table 3: Spatial parameters
spatial_table <- results_df %>%
  arrange(desc(PP_AbsEffect)) %>%
  transmute(
    Predictor   = Label,
    `Range (m)` = sprintf("%.0f", Spatial_Range),
    Sigma       = sprintf("%.3f", Spatial_Sigma),
    DIC         = sprintf("%.1f", DIC),
    WAIC        = ifelse(is.na(WAIC), "—", sprintf("%.1f", WAIC))
  )

cat("\n")
cat("╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat("║             TABLE 3: SPATIAL PARAMETERS BY MODEL                      ║\n")
cat("╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n")
print(spatial_table, row.names = FALSE)

# ==================== FIGURES ====================

# 0) Correlation matrix (re-plot from saved object)
if (!is.null(cor_matrix)) {
  png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "correlation_plot_from_saved.png"), width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
  corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", tl.col = "black", tl.cex = 0.7,
           addCoef.col = "black", number.cex = 0.5,
           col = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(200),
           title = "Correlation Matrix (from saved object)", mar = c(0,0,2,0))
  dev.off()
  message("✓ Saved: correlation_plot_from_saved.png")
}

# Short label for plots
results_df$Label_short <- substr(results_df$Label, 1, 25)

# 1) Occurrence effects (forest)
p1 <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = reorder(Label_short, PP_AbsEffect), y = PP_Effect)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", size = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = PP_CI_Lower, ymax = PP_CI_Upper, color = PP_Significant),
                width = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = PP_Significant), size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Significant\n(95% CI excludes 0)",
                     values = c("FALSE" = "gray60", "TRUE" = "#D7191C"),
                     labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
  labs(title = "Effect of Predictors on Site Occurrence (WHERE)",
       subtitle = "Standardized coefficients from individual LGCP models",
       x = NULL, y = "Effect Size (log relative risk)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "plot_occurrence_effects.png"), p1, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
print(p1)

# 2) Size effects (forest)
p2 <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = reorder(Label_short, Mark_AbsEffect), y = Mark_Effect)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", size = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mark_CI_Lower, ymax = Mark_CI_Upper, color = Mark_Significant),
                width = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Mark_Significant), size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Significant\n(95% CI excludes 0)",
                     values = c("FALSE" = "gray60", "TRUE" = "#2166AC"),
                     labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
  labs(title = "Effect of Predictors on Site Size (HOW LARGE)",
       subtitle = "Standardized coefficients from individual mark models",
       x = NULL, y = "Effect Size (log area)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "plot_size_effects.png"), p2, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
print(p2)

# 3) Occurrence vs Size comparison (bars)
comparison_long <- data.frame(
  Predictor = rep(results_df$Label_short, 2),
  Effect = c(results_df$PP_Effect, results_df$Mark_Effect),
  Type = rep(c("Occurrence (WHERE)", "Size (HOW LARGE)"), each = nrow(results_df)),
  Significant = c(results_df$PP_Significant, results_df$Mark_Significant)
)
p3 <- ggplot(comparison_long, aes(x = reorder(Predictor, abs(Effect)), y = Effect, fill = Type)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", alpha = 0.85) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Occurrence (WHERE)" = "#D7191C",
                               "Size (HOW LARGE)" = "#2166AC")) +
  labs(title = "Comparing Effects: Location vs. Size",
       subtitle = "Do predictors affect WHERE sites occur differently than HOW LARGE they become?",
       x = NULL, y = "Effect Size") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "plot_occ_vs_size.png"), p3, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
print(p3)

# 4) Model fit comparison (DIC)
p4 <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = reorder(Label_short, DIC), y = DIC)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#756BB1", alpha = 0.85) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Model Fit Comparison (DIC)",
       subtitle = "Lower DIC = better fit | Which variable best explains the data alone?",
       x = NULL, y = "DIC") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "plot_model_fit_dic.png"), p4, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
print(p4)

# 5) Spatial range by model
p5 <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = reorder(Label_short, Spatial_Range), y = Spatial_Range/1000)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#31A354", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = max(results_df$Spatial_Range, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
           label = "Prior expectation: 800m", color = "red", size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Spatial Range by Model",
       subtitle = "Distance at which spatial correlation drops | Does adding covariates reduce spatial range?",
       x = NULL, y = "Spatial Range (km)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "plot_spatial_range.png"), p5, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
print(p5)

# 6) Effect size heatmap
heatmap_long <- melt(results_df[, c("Label","PP_Effect","Mark_Effect")], id.vars = "Label")
heatmap_long$variable <- factor(heatmap_long$variable,
                                levels = c("PP_Effect","Mark_Effect"),
                                labels = c("Occurrence","Size"))
lim <- max(abs(heatmap_long$value), na.rm = TRUE)
p6 <- ggplot(heatmap_long, aes(x = variable, y = Label, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", value)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "Effect\nSize", low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#D7191C",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim)) +
  labs(title = "Effect Size Heatmap: Quick Visual Comparison",
       subtitle = "Blue = negative effect | Red = positive effect",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.position = "right")
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "plot_effect_heatmap.png"), p6, width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 300)
print(p6)

# ==================== QUICK SUMMARY ====================
sig_pp   <- sum(results_df$PP_Significant, na.rm = TRUE)
sig_mark <- sum(results_df$Mark_Significant, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("\nSummary:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Successful models: %d\n", nrow(results_df)))
cat(sprintf("  Significant occurrence effects: %d\n", sig_pp))
cat(sprintf("  Significant size effects: %d\n", sig_mark))
cat(sprintf("  Saved plots to: %s\n", OUTPUT_DIR))

```

## Joint Model (Marked LGCP)

```{r}
# ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║      JOINT LGCP MODEL - Independent, Full Predictors                 ║
# ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

library(INLA)
library(inlabru)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# ==================== CONFIGURATION ====================
GRID_FILE     <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Abidjan/R_data/abidjan_grid30m_master_merged_withDV.csv"
SITES_FILE    <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Abidjan/Abidjan_site_locations.csv"
BOUNDARY_FILE <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Abidjan/R_data/Abidjan.shp"

CRS_METR <- 32630
CRS_LL   <- 4326

DISTANCE_THRESHOLD <- 150  # meters

# Full predictor set with display names
VARIABLE_NAMES <- c(
  'rwi_interp'                   = 'Relative Wealth Index',
  'ntl_bilinear'                 = 'Night Time Lights',
  'slum_mean30m'                 = 'Slum Likelihood',
  'mean_footprint_area_m2_250m'  = 'Footprint Area (Mean)',
  'accessibility_index'          = 'Accessibility Index',
  'spacing_median_m_250m'        = 'Footprint Spacing',
  'orientation_dispersion_250m'  = 'Orientation Dispersion',
  'u18_bilinear'                 = 'Under 18 Population',
  'built_environment_index'      = 'Built Environment Index',
  'dist_secondary_m'             = 'Distance to Secondary Roads',
  'dist_tertiary_m'              = 'Distance to Tertiary Roads',
  'clark_evans_R_net_250m'       = 'Clark Evans R Index',
  'dist_to_mask_edge_m_250m'     = 'Distance to Open Space',
  'civ_general_2020'             = 'Population Density'
)

PREDICTORS <- names(VARIABLE_NAMES)

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("JOINT LGCP MODEL - FULL PREDICTORS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# ==================== 1. LOAD DATA ====================
message("Loading data...")

grid  <- read.csv(GRID_FILE, check.names = FALSE)
sites <- read.csv(SITES_FILE, check.names = FALSE)

grid_coords  <- if(all(c("x","y") %in% names(grid))) c("x","y") else c("longitude","latitude")
sites_coords <- if(all(c("x","y") %in% names(sites))) c("x","y") else c("longitude","latitude")
coord_crs    <- if(max(abs(grid[[grid_coords[1]]])) > 180) CRS_METR else CRS_LL

boundary <- st_read(BOUNDARY_FILE, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(CRS_METR) %>% st_make_valid()
grid_sf  <- st_as_sf(grid, coords = grid_coords, crs = coord_crs) %>% st_transform(CRS_METR)
sites_sf <- st_as_sf(sites, coords = sites_coords, crs = coord_crs) %>% st_transform(CRS_METR)

area_col <- if("area_m2" %in% names(sites)) "area_m2" else "area"
sites_sf$log_area <- log(sites[[area_col]])

message("✓ ", nrow(grid_sf), " grid points, ", nrow(sites_sf), " sites")

# Check available predictors
available_preds <- PREDICTORS[PREDICTORS %in% names(grid_sf)]
missing_preds <- setdiff(PREDICTORS, available_preds)

if(length(missing_preds) > 0) {
  message("\n⚠ Missing predictors: ", paste(missing_preds, collapse = ", "))
}

PREDICTORS <- available_preds
message("✓ Using ", length(PREDICTORS), " predictors")

# ==================== 2. CREATE SUPPORT ====================
message("\nCreating support (150m buffer)...")

support <- grid_sf %>%
  st_buffer(DISTANCE_THRESHOLD) %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_intersection(boundary) %>%
  st_make_valid()

support_area_km2 <- as.numeric(st_area(support)) / 1e6
message("✓ Support area: ", round(support_area_km2, 1), " km²")

# Filter grid to support
grid_in_support <- grid_sf[lengths(st_intersects(grid_sf, support)) > 0, ]
message("✓ ", nrow(grid_in_support), " grid points in support")

# ==================== 3. Z-SCORE USING GRID IN SUPPORT ====================
message("\nZ-scoring predictors using grid in support...")

scaling_params <- list()

for(pred in PREDICTORS) {
  vals <- st_drop_geometry(grid_in_support)[[pred]]
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  
  if(length(vals) < 100) {
    warning("Predictor ", pred, " has < 100 valid values in support")
    next
  }
  
  mu <- mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  sdv <- sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if(!is.finite(sdv) || sdv == 0) {
    warning("Predictor ", pred, " has no variation")
    next
  }
  
  scaling_params[[pred]] <- list(mean = mu, sd = sdv)
  message(sprintf("  %-35s: mean=%7.2f, sd=%7.2f", VARIABLE_NAMES[pred], mu, sdv))
}

# Update predictors to those successfully scaled
PREDICTORS <- names(scaling_params)
message("\n✓ ", length(PREDICTORS), " predictors scaled successfully")

# ==================== 4. NN INTERPOLATION HELPER ====================
interp_nn_cap <- function(target_pts, grid_sf, pred, max_dist = 150) {
  grid_valid <- grid_sf[is.finite(st_drop_geometry(grid_sf)[[pred]]), ]
  if(nrow(grid_valid) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(target_pts)))
  
  idx <- st_nearest_feature(target_pts, grid_valid)
  dists <- as.numeric(st_distance(target_pts, grid_valid[idx,], by_element = TRUE))
  vals <- st_drop_geometry(grid_valid)[[pred]][idx]
  vals[dists > max_dist] <- NA_real_
  vals
}

# ==================== 5. FILTER SITES & EXTRACT COVARIATES ====================
message("\nFiltering sites to support...")

sites_sf <- sites_sf[lengths(st_intersects(sites_sf, support)) > 0, ]
message("✓ ", nrow(sites_sf), " sites in support")

message("\nExtracting covariates at sites...")

for(pred in PREDICTORS) {
  # Extract raw
  sites_sf[[paste0(pred, "_raw")]] <- interp_nn_cap(sites_sf, grid_sf, pred, DISTANCE_THRESHOLD)
  
  # Z-score
  sites_sf[[paste0(pred, "_z")]] <- (sites_sf[[paste0(pred, "_raw")]] - 
                                       scaling_params[[pred]]$mean) / 
                                       scaling_params[[pred]]$sd
}

# Check missing data per site
na_counts <- rowSums(is.na(st_drop_geometry(sites_sf[, paste0(PREDICTORS, "_z")])))

# Tolerate up to 1 missing predictor
sites_sf <- sites_sf[na_counts <= 1, ]

message("✓ ", nrow(sites_sf), " sites with ≤1 missing predictor")

if(nrow(sites_sf) < 50) {
  stop("Too few sites remaining (", nrow(sites_sf), "). Check data coverage.")
}

# For sites with 1 missing, impute with 0 (mean of z-scored)
for(pred in PREDICTORS) {
  z_col <- paste0(pred, "_z")
  sites_sf[[z_col]][is.na(sites_sf[[z_col]])] <- 0
}

# ==================== 6. MESH & SPDE ====================
message("\nBuilding mesh...")

mesh <- fm_mesh_2d(
  boundary = fm_as_segm(boundary),
  max.edge = c(500, 3000),
  cutoff   = 300,
  crs      = st_crs(CRS_METR)
)

message("✓ Mesh: ", mesh$n, " nodes")

spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(
  mesh,
  prior.range = c(800, 0.5),
  prior.sigma = c(2, 0.01)
)

# ==================== 7. GENERATE IPS ====================
message("\nGenerating integration points...")

ips <- fm_int(mesh, samplers = support)
message("✓ Generated ", nrow(ips), " integration points")

# ==================== 8. EXTRACT COVARIATES AT IPS ====================
message("\nExtracting covariates at IPs...")

for(pred in PREDICTORS) {
  # Extract (no distance cap - IPs within support)
  grid_valid <- grid_sf[is.finite(st_drop_geometry(grid_sf)[[pred]]), ]
  idx <- st_nearest_feature(ips, grid_valid)
  ips[[paste0(pred, "_raw")]] <- st_drop_geometry(grid_valid)[[pred]][idx]
  
  # Z-score
  ips[[paste0(pred, "_z")]] <- (ips[[paste0(pred, "_raw")]] - 
                                 scaling_params[[pred]]$mean) / 
                                 scaling_params[[pred]]$sd
}

# Impute NAs with 0
for(pred in PREDICTORS) {
  z_col <- paste0(pred, "_z")
  ips[[z_col]][is.na(ips[[z_col]])] <- 0
}

message("✓ Covariates extracted at IPs")

# ==================== 9. BUILD MODEL ====================
message("\nBuilding model components...")

# Build formula dynamically
comp_parts <- "~ Intercept_pp(1) + field(geometry, model = spde)"

for(i in seq_along(PREDICTORS)) {
  pred <- PREDICTORS[i]
  comp_parts <- paste0(comp_parts, " + beta_", gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", pred), 
                      "(main = ", pred, "_z, model = 'linear')")
}

comp_parts <- paste0(comp_parts, " + Intercept_mark(1)")

components <- as.formula(comp_parts)

# Occurrence formula
beta_names <- paste0("beta_", gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", PREDICTORS))
occur_formula <- as.formula(paste("geometry ~ Intercept_pp + field +", 
                                  paste(beta_names, collapse = " + ")))

# Likelihoods
like_pp <- like(
  family = "cp",
  formula = occur_formula,
  data = sites_sf,
  ips = ips
)

like_mark <- like(
  family = "gaussian",
  formula = log_area ~ Intercept_mark + field,
  data = sites_sf
)

message("✓ Model components built")

# ==================== 10. FIT MODEL ====================
cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("FITTING JOINT MODEL (", length(PREDICTORS), " predictors)...\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

start_time <- Sys.time()

fit <- bru(
  components,
  like_pp,
  like_mark,
  options = list(
    control.inla = list(int.strategy = "eb"),
    control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
    bru_verbose = FALSE
  )
)

fit_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "mins"))

cat("\n✓ Fitting completed in ", round(fit_time, 1), " minutes\n\n")

# ==================== 11. RESULTS TABLES ====================

cat("╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat("║                     OCCURRENCE EFFECTS (WHERE)                         ║\n")
cat("╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n")

# Extract occurrence effects
occur_rows <- c("Intercept_pp", beta_names)
occur_effects <- fit$summary.fixed[occur_rows[occur_rows %in% rownames(fit$summary.fixed)], ]

# Create readable table
occur_table <- data.frame(
  Predictor = c("Intercept", VARIABLE_NAMES[PREDICTORS]),
  Coefficient = sprintf("%.4f", occur_effects$mean),
  Std.Error = sprintf("%.4f", occur_effects$sd),
  CI.Lower = sprintf("%.4f", occur_effects$`0.025quant`),
  CI.Upper = sprintf("%.4f", occur_effects$`0.975quant`),
  Significant = ifelse(
    occur_effects$`0.025quant` > 0 | occur_effects$`0.975quant` < 0,
    "***", ""
  ),
  row.names = NULL
)

print(occur_table)

cat("\n╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat("║                        SPATIAL PARAMETERS                              ║\n")
cat("╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n")

spatial_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Range (m)", "Std Dev (σ)", "Mark Precision (τ)"),
  Estimate = sprintf("%.2f", c(
    fit$summary.hyperpar["Range for field", "mean"],
    fit$summary.hyperpar["Stdev for field", "mean"],
    1/fit$summary.hyperpar["Precision for the Gaussian observations[2]", "mean"]
  )),
  CI.Lower = sprintf("%.2f", c(
    fit$summary.hyperpar["Range for field", "0.025quant"],
    fit$summary.hyperpar["Stdev for field", "0.025quant"],
    1/fit$summary.hyperpar["Precision for the Gaussian observations[2]", "0.975quant"]
  )),
  CI.Upper = sprintf("%.2f", c(
    fit$summary.hyperpar["Range for field", "0.975quant"],
    fit$summary.hyperpar["Stdev for field", "0.975quant"],
    1/fit$summary.hyperpar["Precision for the Gaussian observations[2]", "0.025quant"]
  ))
)

print(spatial_table)

cat("\n╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat("║                          MODEL FIT                                     ║\n")
cat("╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n")

cat("Sites used:       ", nrow(sites_sf), "\n")
cat("Predictors:       ", length(PREDICTORS), "\n")
cat("Integration pts:  ", nrow(ips), "\n")
cat("DIC:              ", sprintf("%.2f", fit$dic$dic), "\n")
cat("WAIC:             ", sprintf("%.2f", fit$waic$waic), "\n")
cat("Fitting time:     ", sprintf("%.1f", fit_time), " minutes\n\n")

# ==================== 12. FIGURES ====================

# Forest plot
plot_data <- data.frame(
  Predictor = VARIABLE_NAMES[PREDICTORS],
  Effect = occur_effects$mean[-1],  # Exclude intercept
  Lower = occur_effects$`0.025quant`[-1],
  Upper = occur_effects$`0.975quant`[-1],
  Significant = (occur_effects$`0.025quant`[-1] > 0 | occur_effects$`0.975quant`[-1] < 0)
)

p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(Predictor, abs(Effect)), y = Effect)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, color = Significant), 
                width = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Significant), size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "gray60", "TRUE" = "#D7191C"),
                     name = "Significant") +
  labs(title = "Occurrence Effects - Joint Model",
       subtitle = paste(length(PREDICTORS), "predictors"),
       x = NULL, y = "Effect Size (log relative risk)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p1)

cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("JOINT MODEL COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Store key objects in environment
joint_model_fit <<- fit
joint_model_results <<- list(
  fit = fit,
  sites = sites_sf,
  mesh = mesh,
  spde = spde,
  support = support,
  predictors = PREDICTORS,
  scaling_params = scaling_params,
  tables = list(occurrence = occur_table, spatial = spatial_table),
  plot = p1
)

message("✓ Results stored in: joint_model_fit, joint_model_results")
```

# Visualise Results
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(viridis)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# Set output directory (same as where files were saved)
OUTPUT_DIR <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Abidjan/R_data/joint_model"

# Read saved objects
fit <- readRDS(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "joint_lgcp_fit.rds"))
spatial_objects <- readRDS(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "spatial_objects.rds"))
scaling_params <- readRDS(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "scaling_parameters.rds"))
prediction_objects <- readRDS(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "prediction_objects.rds"))

# Extract objects from saved lists
support <- spatial_objects$support
sites_sf <- spatial_objects$sites_sf
grid_sf <- spatial_objects$grid_sf
boundary <- spatial_objects$boundary

pred_data_sf <- prediction_objects$pred_data_sf
pred_mean <- prediction_objects$pred_mean
pred_sd <- prediction_objects$pred_sd
pred_field <- prediction_objects$pred_field

# Predictor names
FULL_PREDICTORS <- c(
  'rwi_interp'                   = 'Relative Wealth Index',
  'ntl_bilinear'                 = 'Night Time Lights',
  'slum_mean30m'                 = 'Slum Likelihood',
  'mean_footprint_area_m2_250m'  = 'Footprint Area (Mean)',
  'accessibility_index'          = 'Accessibility Index',
  'dist_secondary_m'             = 'Distance to Secondary Roads',
  'spacing_median_m_250m'        = 'Footprint Spacing',
  'orientation_dispersion_250m'  = 'Orientation Dispersion',
  'u18_bilinear'                 = 'Under 18 Population',
  'built_environment_index'      = 'Built Environment Index',
  'dist_tertiary_m'              = 'Distance to Tertiary Roads',
  'clark_evans_R_net_250m'       = 'Clark Evans R Index',
  'dist_to_mask_edge_m_250m'     = 'Distance to Open Space',
  'civ_general_2020'             = 'Population Density'
)

# Theme
lgcp_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(0,0,6,0)),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.height = unit(4, "lines")
  )

# Intensity Map
intensity_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = pred_data_sf, aes(color = pred_mean), size = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = support, fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = st_geometry(sites_sf), color = "red", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Intensity λ(s)", trans = "sqrt") +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  lgcp_theme +
  ggtitle("Predicted Waste Site Intensity")

# Uncertainty Map
uncertainty_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = pred_data_sf, aes(color = pred_sd), size = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = support, fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Uncertainty", option = "magma") +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  lgcp_theme +
  ggtitle("Prediction Uncertainty")

# Spatial Field Map
field_mean <- if ("mean" %in% names(pred_field)) pred_field$mean else pred_field$.mean
spatial_field_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = pred_data_sf, aes(color = field_mean), size = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = support, fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Spatial Field", trans = "sqrt") +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  lgcp_theme +
  ggtitle("Spatial Field (Unmeasured Effects)")

# Covariate Effects
beta_rows <- grep("^beta_", rownames(fit$summary.fixed), value = TRUE)
betas_in_fit <- sub("^beta_", "", beta_rows)
used_covs <- intersect(betas_in_fit, names(FULL_PREDICTORS))

covariate_effects <- data.frame(
  Covariate = FULL_PREDICTORS[used_covs],
  Effect = fit$summary.fixed[paste0("beta_", used_covs), "mean"],
  Lower = fit$summary.fixed[paste0("beta_", used_covs), "0.025quant"],
  Upper = fit$summary.fixed[paste0("beta_", used_covs), "0.975quant"],
  row.names = NULL
)

effects_plot <- ggplot(covariate_effects, aes(x = reorder(Covariate, abs(Effect)), y = Effect)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.6,
    color = ifelse(covariate_effects$Lower > 0 | covariate_effects$Upper < 0, "#b22222", "black")
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Covariate Effects on Waste Site Occurrence",
       x = NULL, y = "Effect Size (log relative risk)") +
  lgcp_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Risk Classification Map
qbreaks <- quantile(pred_mean, probs = c(0, .2, .4, .6, .8, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
pred_data_sf$risk_category <- cut(
  pred_mean, breaks = qbreaks,
  labels = c("Very Low","Low","Medium","High","Very High"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

risk_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = pred_data_sf, aes(color = risk_category), size = 0.9) +
  geom_sf(data = support, fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = st_geometry(sites_sf), color = "black", size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Risk Level",
    values = c("Very Low"="#2c7bb6","Low"="#abd9e9","Medium"="#ffffbf","High"="#fdae61","Very High"="#d7191c")
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  lgcp_theme +
  ggtitle("Waste Site Risk Classification")+
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4)))  # <- bigger legend points

# Arrange and print plots
plots <- list(
  intensity_map,
  uncertainty_map,
  spatial_field_map,
  effects_plot,
  risk_map
)

# Optional: tidy spacing & legends uniformly
tidy_theme <- function(p) {
  p +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(0,0,6,0)),
      legend.key.height = unit(3, "lines"),
      legend.box.margin = margin(4,4,4,4),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 12),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}
plots <- lapply(plots, tidy_theme)

pages <- marrangeGrob(plots, nrow = 1, ncol = 1, top = NULL)
print(pages)

# Print spatial parameters
spatial_params <- readRDS(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "results_tables.rds"))
```

```{r}
  } else if (!is.null(pred_field$.mean)) {

  }
}

field_mean <- as.numeric(field_mean)

# Final sanity check

}

# ---------------------------

coords <- st_coordinates(pred_data_sf)

df_field <- pred_data_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    x = coords[, 1],
    y = coords[, 2],
    field_mean = field_mean
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(y), is.finite(field_mean))

# ---------------------------
# Use raster if regular grid, else tile (with explicit size)
# ---------------------------
is_regular_grid <- function(x, y) {
  ux <- sort(unique(x))
  uy <- sort(unique(y))
  if (length(ux) < 2 || length(uy) < 2) return(FALSE)
  dx <- diff(ux)
  dy <- diff(uy)
  dx <- round(dx[is.finite(dx)], 10)
  dy <- round(dy[is.finite(dy)], 10)
  length(unique(dx)) == 1 && length(unique(dy)) == 1
}

USE_RASTER <- is_regular_grid(df_field$x, df_field$y)

if (!USE_RASTER) {
  dx <- median(diff(sort(unique(df_field$x))), na.rm = TRUE)
  dy <- median(diff(sort(unique(df_field$y))), na.rm = TRUE)
}

# ---------------------------

ggsave(
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)

# Create hexagonal grid with optimized parameters
create_hex_grid <- function(boundary, cell_size = NULL) {
  # If cell_size is not provided, calculate an appropriate size
  if (is.null(cell_size)) {
    # Estimate cell size based on boundary dimensions
    boundary_bbox <- st_bbox(boundary)
    x_range <- boundary_bbox$xmax - boundary_bbox$xmin
    y_range <- boundary_bbox$ymax - boundary_bbox$ymin
    
    # Suggest a cell size that creates a reasonable number of hexes
    cell_size <- min(x_range, y_range) / 70
  }
  
  # Create hexagonal grid
  hex_grid <- st_make_grid(
    boundary, 
    cellsize = cell_size,  # Dynamically determined cell size
    square = FALSE,        # Hexagonal grid
    crs = st_crs(boundary) # Preserve coordinate reference system
  )
  
  # Convert to sf object and clip to boundary
  hex_grid_sf <- st_sf(geometry = hex_grid)
  
  # Intersect with boundary to remove hexes outside the study area
  hex_grid_clipped <- st_intersection(hex_grid_sf, boundary)
  
  return(hex_grid_clipped)
}

# Map prediction points to hexagons
map_points_to_hexes <- function(pred_data_sf, hex_grid) {
  # Perform spatial join to find which hex each point belongs to
  point_hex_mapping <- st_join(
    pred_data_sf, 
    hex_grid, 
    join = st_within
  )
  
  return(point_hex_mapping)
}

# Assign risk to empty hexes using nearest neighbor
assign_risk_to_empty_hexes <- function(hex_grid, points_in_hexes) {
  # Identify hexes without points
  empty_hexes <- hex_grid[!hex_grid$geometry %in% points_in_hexes$geometry, ]
  
  # Find nearest point for each empty hex
  empty_hexes$risk_category <- sapply(empty_hexes$geometry, function(hex) {
    nearest_point <- points_in_hexes[st_nearest_feature(hex, points_in_hexes), ]
    return(nearest_point$risk_category)
  })
  
  return(empty_hexes)
}

# Apply the functions
hex_grid <- create_hex_grid(support)
#hex_grid <- create_hex_grid(support, cell_size = 0.02)
points_in_hexes <- st_set_crs(
  map_points_to_hexes(pred_data_sf, hex_grid), 
  st_crs(hex_grid)
)

# Updated assign_risk_to_empty_hexes function
assign_risk_to_empty_hexes <- function(hex_grid, points_in_hexes) {
  # Identify hexes without points
  empty_hexes <- hex_grid[!st_equals(hex_grid, points_in_hexes, sparse = FALSE)[,1], ]
  
  # Find nearest point for each empty hex
  empty_hexes$risk_category <- sapply(st_geometry(empty_hexes), function(hex) {
    # Ensure consistent CRS
    hex <- st_sfc(hex, crs = st_crs(points_in_hexes))
    
    nearest_point_index <- st_nearest_feature(hex, points_in_hexes)
    nearest_point <- points_in_hexes[nearest_point_index, ]
    return(nearest_point$risk_category)
  })
  
  return(empty_hexes)
}

# Apply the functions
filled_hexes <- assign_risk_to_empty_hexes(hex_grid, points_in_hexes)

# Combine hexes with and without points
all_hexes <- rbind(
  points_in_hexes %>% select(geometry, risk_category),
  filled_hexes %>% select(geometry, risk_category)
)

# Optional: Check the results
print(nrow(all_hexes))
print(table(all_hexes$risk_category))

# Visualization
risk_map_hex <- ggplot() +
  # Hexagonal grid with risk categories
  geom_sf(
    data = all_hexes, 
    aes(fill = risk_category),
    color = "white",  # White borders between hexes
    size = 0.1,       # Thin border
    alpha = 0.7       # Slight transparency
  ) +
  # Study area boundary
  geom_sf(
    data = support, 
    fill = NA, 
    color = "grey30", 
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  # Waste site locations
  geom_sf(
    data = sites_sf, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 0.9, 
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  # Color scheme matching original visualization
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Risk Level",
    values = c(
      "Very Low"  = "#2c7bb6",
      "Low"       = "#abd9e9",
      "Medium"    = "#ffffbf",
      "High"      = "#fdae61",
      "Very High" = "#d7191c"
    )
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  lgcp_theme +
  ggtitle("Waste Site Risk Classification (Hexagonal)")

# Print the map
print(risk_map_hex)
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)   # unit()
library(Cairo)  # cairo_pdf

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# ============================================================
# ASSUMES these already exist from your earlier load script:
#   OUTPUT_DIR, support, sites_sf, pred_data_sf, pred_mean, lgcp_theme
# If not, uncomment and set them accordingly.
# ============================================================
OUTPUT_DIR <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Abidjan/R_data/joint_model"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Theme edits (NO TITLE + Easting/Northing offsets + full-height legend)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
lgcp_theme_hex <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 12),

    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),

    axis.text.x  = element_text(margin = margin(t = 4)),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(margin = margin(r = 4)),

    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),

    # key sizes (fixes distortion)
    legend.key.height = unit(0.55, "cm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(0.55, "cm"),

    # spacing so it reads cleanly
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "cm")
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Build risk categories on prediction points (so points_in_hexes has class)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pred_data_sf <- pred_data_sf %>% mutate(pred_mean = pred_mean)

qbreaks <- quantile(pred_data_sf$pred_mean, probs = c(0, .2, .4, .6, .8, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
pred_data_sf$risk_category <- cut(
  pred_data_sf$pred_mean, breaks = qbreaks,
  labels = c("Very Low", "Low", "Medium", "High", "Very High"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

# Force desired legend order (top to bottom)
risk_levels <- c("Very High", "High", "Medium", "Low", "Very Low")
pred_data_sf$risk_category <- factor(as.character(pred_data_sf$risk_category), levels = risk_levels)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Hex grid
# ------------------------------------------------------------
support <- st_make_valid(support) %>% st_union()

create_hex_grid <- function(boundary, cell_size = NULL) {
  if (is.null(cell_size)) {
    boundary_bbox <- st_bbox(boundary)
    x_range <- as.numeric(boundary_bbox$xmax - boundary_bbox$xmin)
    y_range <- as.numeric(boundary_bbox$ymax - boundary_bbox$ymin)
    cell_size <- min(x_range, y_range) / 70
  }

  hex_grid <- st_make_grid(
    boundary,
    cellsize = cell_size,
    square = FALSE,
    crs = st_crs(boundary)
  )

  hex_grid_sf <- st_sf(hex_id = seq_along(hex_grid), geometry = hex_grid, crs = st_crs(boundary))
  hex_grid_clipped <- st_intersection(hex_grid_sf, boundary)

  # Make stable for ggplot
  hex_grid_clipped %>%
    st_make_valid() %>%
    st_collection_extract("POLYGON", warn = FALSE) %>%
    st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON", warn = FALSE) %>%
    filter(!st_is_empty(geometry))
}

hex_grid <- create_hex_grid(support)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Map points to hexes (fast + stable): use st_intersects list
#    then take mode (majority) risk class per hex
# ------------------------------------------------------------
risk_pts <- pred_data_sf %>% filter(!is.na(risk_category))

idx_list <- st_intersects(hex_grid, risk_pts)  # list: points in each hex

mode_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  tab <- table(x)
  names(tab)[which.max(tab)]
}

hex_grid$risk_category <- vapply(
  idx_list,
  function(ii) mode_chr(risk_pts$risk_category[ii]),
  FUN.VALUE = character(1)
)

# Keep NA as NA (holes/excluded areas remain grey)
hex_grid$risk_category <- factor(as.character(hex_grid$risk_category), levels = risk_levels)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Plot (NO TITLE, ordered legend incl. NA, Easting/Northing labels)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
risk_palette <- c(
  "Very Low"  = "#2c7bb6",
  "Low"       = "#abd9e9",
  "Medium"    = "#ffffbf",
  "High"      = "#fdae61",
  "Very High" = "#d7191c"
)

risk_map_hex <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = hex_grid,
    aes(fill = risk_category),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.05,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = support, fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = sites_sf, color = "black", size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Risk Level",
    values = risk_palette,
    breaks = risk_levels,       # legend order (top to bottom)
    drop = FALSE,
    na.value = "grey70",        # NA category colour
    guide = guide_legend(
      ncol=1,
      byrow= TRUE,
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1, color=NA),
      reverse = FALSE
    )
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Easting", y = "Northing") +
  lgcp_theme_hex

print(risk_map_hex)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Save high-definition outputs (PDF + 600dpi PNG)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "risk_map_hex_no_title.pdf"),
  plot = risk_map_hex,
  width = 7.0, height = 4.5, units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "risk_map_hex_no_title.png"),
  plot = risk_map_hex,
  width = 7.0, height = 4.5, units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  type = "cairo"
)

message("Saved to: ", OUTPUT_DIR)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# LGCP FIGURE EXPORT WORKFLOW (CITY-GENERIC)
#   1) Spatial Field (Unmeasured Effects) as gapless pixels (raster/tile)
#   2) Waste Site Risk Classification as HEX grid (mode class per hex)
#   3) Saves: each figure individually + side-by-side composite
#
# NOTES:
# - Assumes you have saved:
#     spatial_objects.rds  (support, sites_sf, boundary/grid if present)
#     prediction_objects.rds (pred_data_sf, pred_mean, pred_field, ...)
# - Will NOT assume anything is preloaded.
# - Keeps NA hexes grey (holes/excluded areas will remain NA if no points).
# ============================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(grid)      # unit()
library(gridExtra) # arrangeGrob
library(Cairo)     # cairo_pdf device

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# ---------------------------
# USER INPUT
# ---------------------------
OUTPUT_DIR <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Abidjan/R_data/joint_model"

# Filenames (prefix makes it easy to reuse per city)
CITY_TAG <- "abidjan"  # change per city (e.g., "lagos", "nairobi")

# Figure export sizes
W_SINGLE <- 7.0
H_SINGLE <- 4.5
DPI_PNG  <- 600

# Hex grid density: smaller divisor -> bigger hexes; bigger divisor -> smaller hexes
HEX_DIVISOR <- 70

# ---------------------------
# Load objects
# ---------------------------
spatial_objects    <- readRDS(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "spatial_objects.rds"))
prediction_objects <- readRDS(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "prediction_objects.rds"))

support      <- spatial_objects$support
sites_sf     <- spatial_objects$sites_sf
pred_data_sf <- prediction_objects$pred_data_sf
pred_mean    <- prediction_objects$pred_mean
pred_field   <- prediction_objects$pred_field

# ---------------------------
# CRS + validity safety
# ---------------------------
pred_crs <- st_crs(pred_data_sf)
support  <- st_make_valid(support)  %>% st_transform(pred_crs)
sites_sf <- st_make_valid(sites_sf) %>% st_transform(pred_crs)

# Union support to simplify geometry (faster for hex clipping)
support_u <- st_union(support)

# ============================================================
# THEME (shared look; no title; axis label offsets)
# ============================================================
base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 12),

    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),

    axis.text.x  = element_text(margin = margin(t = 4)),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(margin = margin(r = 4)),

    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# ============================================================
# 1) SPATIAL FIELD (UNMEASURED EFFECTS) — pixels (raster/tile)
# ============================================================

# --- Extract field mean robustly
n <- nrow(pred_data_sf)
field_mean <- NULL

if (is.data.frame(pred_field) || inherits(pred_field, "sf")) {
  if ("mean" %in% names(pred_field)) {
    field_mean <- pred_field[["mean"]]
  } else if (".mean" %in% names(pred_field)) {
    field_mean <- pred_field[[".mean"]]
  }
}
if (is.null(field_mean) && is.list(pred_field)) {
  if (!is.null(pred_field$mean)) {
    field_mean <- pred_field$mean
  } else if (!is.null(pred_field$.mean)) {
    field_mean <- pred_field$.mean
  }
}
field_mean <- as.numeric(field_mean)

if (length(field_mean) != n) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "Could not align field_mean with pred_data_sf. nrow(pred_data_sf)=%d but length(field_mean)=%d.\nRun: str(pred_field); names(pred_field)",
    n, length(field_mean)
  ))
}

# --- Build plotting dataframe (x/y + field)
coords <- st_coordinates(pred_data_sf)
df_field <- pred_data_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    x = coords[, 1],
    y = coords[, 2],
    field_mean = field_mean
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(y), is.finite(field_mean))

# --- Decide raster vs tile
is_regular_grid <- function(x, y) {
  ux <- sort(unique(x))
  uy <- sort(unique(y))
  if (length(ux) < 2 || length(uy) < 2) return(FALSE)
  dx <- round(diff(ux)[is.finite(diff(ux))], 10)
  dy <- round(diff(uy)[is.finite(diff(uy))], 10)
  length(unique(dx)) == 1 && length(unique(dy)) == 1
}
USE_RASTER <- is_regular_grid(df_field$x, df_field$y)

if (!USE_RASTER) {
  dx <- median(diff(sort(unique(df_field$x))), na.rm = TRUE)
  dy <- median(diff(sort(unique(df_field$y))), na.rm = TRUE)
}

spatial_field_map_px <- ggplot(df_field, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  (if (USE_RASTER) {
    geom_raster(aes(fill = field_mean))
  } else {
    geom_tile(aes(fill = field_mean), width = dx, height = dy)
  }) +
  geom_sf(data = support_u, fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Spatial Field", trans = "sqrt") +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Easting", y = "Northing") +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    legend.key.height = unit(4, "lines")  # nice continuous legend height
  )

# ============================================================
# 2) WASTE SITE RISK CLASSIFICATION — hex grid
# ============================================================

# --- Risk categories on points
pred_data_sf <- pred_data_sf %>% mutate(pred_mean = pred_mean)

qbreaks <- quantile(pred_data_sf$pred_mean, probs = c(0, .2, .4, .6, .8, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
pred_data_sf$risk_category <- cut(
  pred_data_sf$pred_mean, breaks = qbreaks,
  labels = c("Very Low", "Low", "Medium", "High", "Very High"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

# Desired legend order (TOP -> BOTTOM)
risk_levels <- c("Very High", "High", "Medium", "Low", "Very Low", "NA")

pred_data_sf$risk_category <- as.character(pred_data_sf$risk_category)
pred_data_sf$risk_category[is.na(pred_data_sf$risk_category)] <- NA_character_  # keep NA on points as NA
pred_data_sf$risk_category <- factor(pred_data_sf$risk_category, levels = risk_levels)

risk_palette <- c(
  "Very Low"  = "#2c7bb6",
  "Low"       = "#abd9e9",
  "Medium"    = "#ffffbf",
  "High"      = "#fdae61",
  "Very High" = "#d7191c",
  "NA"        = "grey70"
)

# --- Create hex grid (clip to support)
create_hex_grid <- function(boundary, divisor = 70) {
  bb <- st_bbox(boundary)
  x_range <- as.numeric(bb$xmax - bb$xmin)
  y_range <- as.numeric(bb$ymax - bb$ymin)
  cell_size <- min(x_range, y_range) / divisor

  hex <- st_make_grid(boundary, cellsize = cell_size, square = FALSE, crs = st_crs(boundary))
  hex_sf <- st_sf(hex_id = seq_along(hex), geometry = hex, crs = st_crs(boundary))

  # Clip to boundary
  out <- st_intersection(hex_sf, boundary) %>%
    st_make_valid() %>%
    st_collection_extract("POLYGON", warn = FALSE) %>%
    st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON", warn = FALSE) %>%
    filter(!st_is_empty(geometry))

  out
}

hex_grid <- create_hex_grid(support_u, divisor = HEX_DIVISOR)

# --- Assign risk to hexes by majority class of contained points
risk_pts <- pred_data_sf %>% filter(!is.na(risk_category))

idx_list <- st_intersects(hex_grid, risk_pts)

mode_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  tab <- table(x)
  names(tab)[which.max(tab)]
}

hex_grid$risk_category <- vapply(
  idx_list,
  function(ii) mode_chr(risk_pts$risk_category[ii]),
  FUN.VALUE = character(1)
)

# Convert NA -> "NA" label so it appears in legend
hex_grid$risk_category[is.na(hex_grid$risk_category)] <- "NA"
hex_grid$risk_category <- factor(hex_grid$risk_category, levels = risk_levels)

risk_map_hex <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = hex_grid,
    aes(fill = risk_category),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.05,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = support_u, fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = sites_sf, color = "black", size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Risk Level",
    values = risk_palette,
    breaks = risk_levels, # ensures top->bottom order
    drop = FALSE,
    guide = guide_legend(
      ncol = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1, color = NA)
    )
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Easting", y = "Northing") +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    legend.key.height = unit(0.55, "cm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(0.55, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y  = unit(0.2, "cm")
  )

# ============================================================
# 3) SAVE INDIVIDUAL FIGURES
# ============================================================

# Spatial field
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(CITY_TAG, "_spatial_field_unmeasured_effects.pdf")),
  plot = spatial_field_map_px,
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Quantifying the LGCP spatial field ("unmeasured effects")
# Using SAVED objects only: fit, pred_data_sf, pred_field
# Outputs: 3 clean tables
# ============================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# -----------------------------
# 0) Basic inputs + checks
# -----------------------------
stopifnot(exists("fit"), exists("pred_data_sf"), exists("pred_field"))
stopifnot("mean" %in% names(pred_field))

u <- pred_field$mean
stopifnot(length(u) == nrow(pred_data_sf))

# Identify z-scored covariates available in prediction points
z_cols <- grep("_z$", names(pred_data_sf), value = TRUE)
z_cols <- setdiff(z_cols, c("Intercept_z"))  # just in case

# -----------------------------
# 1) Construct covariate component Xβ (posterior mean)
# -----------------------------
beta_rows <- grep("^beta_", rownames(fit$summary.fixed), value = TRUE)

# Convert beta names -> covariate columns in pred_data_sf
beta_covs   <- sub("^beta_", "", beta_rows)
beta_covs_z <- paste0(beta_covs, "_z")

# Keep only those that actually exist in pred_data_sf
keep <- beta_covs_z %in% z_cols
beta_rows   <- beta_rows[keep]
beta_covs_z <- beta_covs_z[keep]

stopifnot(length(beta_rows) > 0)

beta_mean <- fit$summary.fixed[beta_rows, "mean"]
names(beta_mean) <- beta_covs_z

X <- as.matrix(st_drop_geometry(pred_data_sf)[, beta_covs_z, drop = FALSE])
Xbeta <- as.numeric(X %*% beta_mean)

# -----------------------------
# TABLE 1: Linear predictor variance decomposition
# NOTE: Var(u) uses the *posterior mean field* across space
# -----------------------------
var_cov   <- var(Xbeta, na.rm = TRUE)
var_field <- var(u, na.rm = TRUE)
var_total <- var(Xbeta + u, na.rm = TRUE)

variance_table <- data.frame(
  Component = c("Covariates (Xβ)", "Spatial field u(s)", "Total (Xβ + u)"),
  Variance = signif(c(var_cov, var_field, var_total), 6),
  Share_of_total = signif(c(var_cov/var_total, var_field/var_total, 1), 6),
  row.names = NULL
)

cat("\n==================== TABLE 1: Variance Decomposition (η = Xβ + u) ====================\n")
print(variance_table)

cat("\nSpatial field share of total linear-predictor variance:",
    signif(var_field / var_total, 6), "\n")

# -----------------------------
# TABLE 2: Magnitude of unmeasured effects (|u(s)|)
# -----------------------------
magnitude_table <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Mean |u(s)|", "Median |u(s)|", "90th percentile |u(s)|", "Max |u(s)|"),
  Value  = signif(c(
    mean(abs(u), na.rm = TRUE),
    median(abs(u), na.rm = TRUE),
    quantile(abs(u), 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(abs(u), na.rm = TRUE)
  ), 6),
  row.names = NULL
)

cat("\n==================== TABLE 2: Spatial Field Magnitude (local deviations) ====================\n")
print(magnitude_table)

# -----------------------------
# TABLE 3: Dominance of unmeasured vs measured component
# -----------------------------
R <- abs(u) / (abs(Xbeta) + 1e-6)

dominance_table <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Median |u| / |Xβ|", "% locations where |u| > |Xβ|"),
  Value  = c(
    signif(median(R, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    signif(mean(R > 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 6)
  ),
  row.names = NULL
)

cat("\n==================== TABLE 3: Dominance Diagnostics ====================\n")
print(dominance_table)
```

# Screening model

```{r}
# ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║          ACCRA SCREENING: Per-Covariate Support + Grid Scaling      ║
# ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

library(INLA)
library(inlabru)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# ==================== CONFIGURATION ====================

GRID_FILE     <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Accra/R_data/accra_grid30m_master_merged_withDV.csv"
SITES_FILE    <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Accra/Accra_site_locations.csv"
BOUNDARY_FILE <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Accra/R_data/Accra.shp"
OUTPUT_DIR    <- "C:/Users/sachi/OneDrive/Documents/Doctoral Work/Results/Paper 2/2024/Accra/R_data/screening_final"

dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

CRS_METR <- 32630
CRS_LL   <- 4326

DISTANCE_THRESHOLD <- 150  # meters

# Full variable set
VARIABLE_NAMES <- c(
  'rwi_interp'                   = 'Relative Wealth Index',
  'ntl_bilinear'                 = 'Night Time Lights',
  'slum_mean30m'                 = 'Slum Likelihood',
  'mean_footprint_area_m2_250m'  = 'Footprint Area (Mean)',
  'accessibility_index'          = 'Accessibility Index',
  'spacing_median_m_250m'        = 'Footprint Spacing',
  'orientation_dispersion_250m'  = 'Orientation Dispersion',
  'u18_bilinear'                 = 'Under 18 Population',
  'built_environment_index'      = 'Built Environment Index',
  'dist_secondary_m'             = 'Distance to Secondary Roads',
  'dist_tertiary_m'              = 'Distance to Tertiary Roads',
  'clark_evans_R_net_250m'       = 'Clark Evans R Index',
  'dist_to_mask_edge_m_250m'     = 'Distance to Open Space',
  'gha_general_2020'             = 'Population Density'
)
covars <- names(VARIABLE_NAMES)

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SCREENING: Per-Covariate Support + Grid-Based Z-Scoring\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# ==================== LOAD DATA ====================

grid  <- read.csv(GRID_FILE, check.names = FALSE)
sites <- read.csv(SITES_FILE, check.names = FALSE)

grid_coords  <- if(all(c("x","y") %in% names(grid))) c("x","y") else c("longitude","latitude")
sites_coords <- if(all(c("x","y") %in% names(sites))) c("x","y") else c("longitude","latitude")
coord_crs    <- if(max(abs(grid[[grid_coords[1]]])) > 180) CRS_METR else CRS_LL

boundary <- st_read(BOUNDARY_FILE, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(CRS_METR) %>% st_make_valid()
grid_sf  <- st_as_sf(grid, coords = grid_coords, crs = coord_crs) %>% st_transform(CRS_METR)
sites_sf <- st_as_sf(sites, coords = sites_coords, crs = coord_crs) %>% st_transform(CRS_METR)

area_col <- if("area_m2" %in% names(sites)) "area_m2" else "area"
sites_sf$log_area <- log(sites[[area_col]])

# Filter to available covariates
missing <- setdiff(covars, names(grid))
if(length(missing) > 0) {
  cat("⚠ Missing covariates (dropped):", paste(missing, collapse=", "), "\n\n")
  covars <- intersect(covars, names(grid))
  VARIABLE_NAMES <- VARIABLE_NAMES[covars]
}

message("✓ ", nrow(grid_sf), " grid points, ", nrow(sites_sf), " sites, ", length(covars), " covariates")

# ==================== CORRELATION ====================

cat("\nComputing correlation matrix...\n")
cov_data <- st_drop_geometry(grid_sf)[, covars]
cor_matrix <- suppressWarnings(cor(cov_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))

png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "correlation_plot.png"), width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", tl.col = "black", tl.cex = 0.7,
         addCoef.col = "black", number.cex = 0.5,
         col = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(200),
         title = "Correlation Matrix", mar = c(0,0,2,0))
dev.off()
message("✓ Saved correlation plot")

# ==================== MESH & SPDE ====================

mesh <- fm_mesh_2d(
  boundary = fm_as_segm(boundary),
  max.edge = c(500, 3000), #500, 3000
  cutoff   = 300,          #300
  crs      = st_crs(CRS_METR)
)

spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(mesh, prior.range = c(800, 0.5), prior.sigma = c(2, 0.01))
message("✓ Mesh: ", mesh$n, " nodes\n")

# ==================== HELPERS ====================

# Distance-capped NN interpolation
interp_nn_cap <- function(target_pts, grid_valid, covar_name, max_dist) {
  if (nrow(grid_valid) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(target_pts)))
  idx <- st_nearest_feature(target_pts, grid_valid)
  dists <- as.numeric(st_distance(target_pts, grid_valid[idx, ], by_element = TRUE))
  vals <- st_drop_geometry(grid_valid)[[covar_name]][idx]
  vals[dists > max_dist] <- NA_real_
  vals
}

# Create support as buffered grid points
create_support <- function(grid_valid, buffer_m) {
  if (nrow(grid_valid) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  support <- grid_valid %>%
    st_buffer(buffer_m) %>%
    st_union() %>%
    st_make_valid() %>%
    st_intersection(boundary) %>%
    st_make_valid()
  
  if (length(support) == 0 || any(st_is_empty(support))) return(NULL)
  support
}

# ==================== FIT INDIVIDUAL MODELS ====================

fit_individual_model <- function(covar_name, covar_label) {
  cat(sprintf("%-40s", covar_label)); flush.console()
  
  # Valid grid points
  grid_valid <- grid_sf[is.finite(st_drop_geometry(grid_sf)[[covar_name]]), ]
  if (nrow(grid_valid) < 100) { cat("SKIPPED (few grid pts)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  # Support polygon
  support <- create_support(grid_valid, DISTANCE_THRESHOLD)
  if (is.null(support)) { cat("SKIPPED (no support)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  # Grid in support for z-scoring
  grid_in_support <- grid_valid[lengths(st_intersects(grid_valid, support)) > 0, ]
  if (nrow(grid_in_support) < 100) { cat("SKIPPED (few grid in support)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  g_vals <- st_drop_geometry(grid_in_support)[[covar_name]]
  g_mean <- mean(g_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  g_sd   <- sd(g_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(g_sd) || g_sd == 0) { cat("SKIPPED (no variation)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  # IPs in support
  ips <- fm_int(mesh, samplers = support)
  if (nrow(ips) < 200) { cat("SKIPPED (few IPs)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  ips$cov_raw <- interp_nn_cap(ips, grid_valid, covar_name, DISTANCE_THRESHOLD)
  ips$cov_z <- (ips$cov_raw - g_mean) / g_sd
  ips_clean <- ips[!is.na(ips$cov_z), ]
  if (nrow(ips_clean) < 200) { cat("SKIPPED (few valid IPs)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  # Sites in support
  sites_in_support <- sites_sf[lengths(st_intersects(sites_sf, support)) > 0, ]
  if (nrow(sites_in_support) < 10) { cat("SKIPPED (few sites)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  sites_in_support$cov_raw <- interp_nn_cap(sites_in_support, grid_valid, covar_name, DISTANCE_THRESHOLD)
  sites_in_support$cov_z <- (sites_in_support$cov_raw - g_mean) / g_sd
  sites_in_support[[paste0(covar_name, "_z")]] <- sites_in_support$cov_z
  sites_use <- sites_in_support[is.finite(sites_in_support$cov_z), ]
  
  if (nrow(sites_use) < 10) { cat("SKIPPED (few valid sites)\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  scaled_name <- paste0(covar_name, "_z")
  support_km2 <- as.numeric(st_area(support)) / 1e6
  
  cat(sprintf("[%d/%d sites, %d IPs, %.1f km²] ", 
              nrow(sites_use), nrow(sites_sf), nrow(ips_clean), support_km2))
  
  # Components
  cmp <- ~ Intercept_pp(1) +
          field_pp(geometry, model = spde) +
          beta_pp(main = cov_z, model = "linear") +
          Intercept_mark(1) +
          beta_mark(main = get(scaled_name), model = "linear")
  
  # Likelihoods
  lh_pp <- like(family = "cp", formula = geometry ~ Intercept_pp + field_pp + beta_pp,
                data = sites_use, ips = ips_clean)
  lh_mark <- like(family = "gaussian", formula = log_area ~ Intercept_mark + beta_mark,
                  data = sites_use)
  
  # Fit
  fit <- try(bru(components = cmp, lh_pp, lh_mark,
                 options = list(control.inla = list(int.strategy = "eb"), bru_verbose = 0)),
             silent = TRUE)
  
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error") || is.null(fit) || is.null(fit$summary.fixed)) {
    cat("FAILED\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Results
  res <- list(
    covariate = covar_name,
    covariate_label = covar_label,
    pp_effect = fit$summary.fixed["beta_pp","mean"],
    pp_se = fit$summary.fixed["beta_pp","sd"],
    pp_ci_lower = fit$summary.fixed["beta_pp","0.025quant"],
    pp_ci_upper = fit$summary.fixed["beta_pp","0.975quant"],
    pp_significant = (fit$summary.fixed["beta_pp","0.025quant"] > 0 | fit$summary.fixed["beta_pp","0.975quant"] < 0),
    mark_effect = fit$summary.fixed["beta_mark","mean"],
    mark_se = fit$summary.fixed["beta_mark","sd"],
    mark_ci_lower = fit$summary.fixed["beta_mark","0.025quant"],
    mark_ci_upper = fit$summary.fixed["beta_mark","0.975quant"],
    mark_significant = (fit$summary.fixed["beta_mark","0.025quant"] > 0 | fit$summary.fixed["beta_mark","0.975quant"] < 0),
    spatial_range = fit$summary.hyperpar["Range for field_pp","mean"],
    spatial_sigma = fit$summary.hyperpar["Stdev for field_pp","mean"],
    dic = fit$dic$dic,
    n_sites_used = nrow(sites_use),
    n_ips_used = nrow(ips_clean),
    support_area_km2 = support_km2
  )
  
  cat(sprintf("✓ PP:%+.3f Mark:%+.3f\n", res$pp_effect, res$mark_effect))
  res
}

# ==================== RUN MODELS ====================

cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("FITTING MODELS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

start_time <- Sys.time()
all_results <- list()

for (i in seq_along(covars)) {
  r <- fit_individual_model(covars[i], VARIABLE_NAMES[covars[i]])
  if (!is.null(r)) all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- r
}

total_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "mins"))

cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat(sprintf("Completed %d / %d models in %.1f minutes\n", length(all_results), length(covars), total_time))
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# ==================== SAVE RESULTS ====================

if (length(all_results) > 0) {
  results_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_results, as.data.frame))
  
  saveRDS(list(results = results_df, cor_matrix = cor_matrix, mesh = mesh, spde = spde),
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "screening_results.rds"))
  write.csv(results_df, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "screening_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("✓ Results saved to:", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠ No models completed\n")
}
```

```{r}
# Table 2: Size (HOW LARGE)
```
